<notes>
kept -> base harness -> All three rollouts (base1, inv1, dom1) completed successfully with delivered=yes. The inv1 and dom1 candidates both show harness.diff "(no change)", confirming they use the identical harness as the base. The three different final answers (33, 70, 47) reflect model sampling variance for the same input, not a harness failure—each trajectory shows the harness executing its workflow correctly: one LLM call, system/task prompts substituted properly, last non-empty line extracted and returned. No trajectory shows a mechanical failure, tool misuse, or control-flow error that an edit would address. No repeated failure pattern exists across the base set (which is 1 rollout). Per mission: a single good outcome per candidate is weak evidence either way, and an edit earns its place when a specific trajectory moment shows the mechanism—here there is no such moment.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
